title: Objective (proposal)
description: Framework proposal; no open schema exists for an objective. Attributes from Table 19.1 and components C1.1, C1.5, C1.6 [2] [11] [20]. Marked a proposal until someone other than the author has used it.

id.description: Persistent identifier, unique within the organization.

catalog_version.description: Catalog version the record was created under (C1.1; seventh principle: currency is a field).

schema_version.description: Version of this schema the record validates against.

version.description: Version of this record; rises on every change (nothing changes silently).

owner.description: Named owner (a person or role, never a function alone).

parent_objective_id.description: Objective this one rolls up to.

appetite_position.description: Position on the appetite scale for the category (C1.3, C1.4) [4] [6].

tolerance.description: Acceptable variation in the measure of the objective (C1.5, C1.6) [2].

aggregated_likelihood_of_miss.description: Aggregated likelihood of the objective being missed (chapter 24, open problem 1).

risk_ids.description: Risks that point to this objective.
